steps.content: New Notification Top streamer Thalia makes her triumphant return, bringing you even more surprises!
New Notification The real Great Expo? Countless treasures, all in Thalia's stream! Tonight at 7:00 PM, don't miss out! Set a reminder now! 3 more notifications
New Notification Thalia is streaming...
Image Noise Effect

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: My dear viewers, it's been too long! Did you miss me these past few days?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh, don't worry, I could never forget about you all! Actually, while I was away, I've been... let's say, curating something very special. And today, I finally get to share it with you!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: That's right! These stunning pieces behind me? They're not just pretty decorations. Every single one is a genuine antique!

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I spent so much time researching these pieces to give you all the best experience possible.

It's like stepping into an exclusive exhibition, with Thalia as its most erudite curator. She doesn't just display the craftsmanship; she unveils the historical eras, the stories behind each piece's creation, weaving it all into her expert commentary for the audience.
And Thalia knows this city's pulse. Most of what she showcases are Outland crafts.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Take this piece, for instance, a handwoven Fraser carpet, centuries old and still in such pristine condition. The pattern you see here depicts Fraser's most renowned port from over a century ago.
Beyond the stream, social media erupts. Few care about the artifacts themselves; they're too busy dissecting the Outlands, their politics, their very existence.
Piece by piece, the collection unfolds on the table, and the viewer count swells, until Thalia shatters the platform's record.
Then, as the number makes one final leap, she sets down the artifact in her hands, smooths her jacket, and turns to the camera. Her posture remains perfectly straight, as always.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: However...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: These collectibles are actually smuggled goods. And not just any smuggled goods, they're contaminated with Mania.
Thalia smiles serenely at the screen and gives slow, deliberate nods. Yet her unshakable composure only pours gasoline on the fire, igniting a fresh storm of furious comments.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: That's right, that's right. "Disregard for the law," "utterly deranged"—you're all spot on.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But here's the real kicker: this batch of goods didn't just magically appear out of thin air.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Over the past few days, someone went through a lot of trouble to track me down. They wanted me to help move these goods, all for her profit, of course.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And that person is none other than Eastside's most celebrated philanthropist, Kara Henninger.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh yes, Miss Henninger and I go way back. That's why she came to me for help. But here's the thing: she also threatened me. If I didn't play along? Well... let's just say the consequences wouldn't be pretty.
Thalia picks up the voice recorder—left untouched on the table the entire stream—gives it a quick shake, and presses play.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: If I can corner you this easily, imagine what else I could do. Ruin isn't even the half of it.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: But why go there? Just help me move these pieces quietly, and we'll call it even.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If anyone missed it, just let me know in the comments. I don't mind playing it again for you all.

The instant the recording plays, the livestream erupts into chaos. Viewers flood the chat, their frenzied keystrokes sending a tidal wave of comments—so many that the feed seizes, overwhelmed, freezing mid-scroll.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: By bringing all of this into the light, I've made my stance clear.
Thalia pauses, her next words hanging unspoken. Then, as she breaks the silence, something unreadable flashes in her gaze.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I've been streaming for years now, going from a complete nobody to where I am today. And I know exactly what drew most of you to me. The whole "inspirational fallen heiress" story.
Thalia gives a knowing smile, her eyes narrowing slightly.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Yes, I'll admit it, it was a marketing angle. But it worked so well that I've used it from day one until now. For so long that... sometimes, I'm not even sure if it's still just an act or if it's become a part of me.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But recently, I received a letter from a fan. She lives in Syndicate, just like I once did, and for that exact reason, she watches my stream every day.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: She has watched me climb back from Syndicate step by step, from an unknown nobody to where I am today.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: She told me she believes that one day, she can build a better life too, through hard work, honestly and steadily. And she asked me... to never change.
Her gaze pierces through the screen, finding only those who truly listen.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I want to protect that dream. So I won't change. Because that's my dream, too.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Even if there are consequences, I refuse to betray the people who believe in me. So, Kara Henninger, if you're coming for me, then come.
A thunderous crash interrupts her—the splintering of a door being forced open. Yet Thalia's eyes remain locked on the camera, unflinching.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Whatever comes next, I trust that you, my dear viewers, will see the truth for what it is.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I am Thalia Ellington. Thank you... for being here with me tonight.
[Empty Shot]
[Empty Shot]
[Empty Shot]
At the same moment, in an opulent Eastside living room somewhere in Eastside, Thalia's face shatters across the wall-mounted display.
The woman before it is deathly pale, her breath ragged, still frozen in the position from hurling the remote at the TV screen.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: Oh, fine... Thalia, this was your choice.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: And once again, you've picked... the wrong path.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: How amusing. How very amusing...
Then, without warning, she erupts into laughter, jagged and unhinged, before gasping as if the sound has hollowed her out.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: Where are they?

steps.speaker: Assistant
steps.content: They've already broken in, searching for where she's hiding—
Before the man can finish, she seizes him by the collar.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: Listen to me, I don't give a damn about the fallout. I want her to pay for this—
Open the door!

steps.speaker: Officer A
steps.content: FAC Public Security Bureau. We have a search and arrest warrant for you. You and your family are now in custody. You are required to cooperate fully with our investigation.
The people in the room are clearly caught off guard. The assistant jerks into motion, fumbling for a weapon, but FAC operatives are already upon them, restraint swift and merciless.

steps.speaker: Officer A
steps.content: All targets are in custody. What's your status?

steps.speaker: Officer B
steps.content: Copy that. We're inside the building and moving toward the target location.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please keep Miss Thalia safe at all costs.
The other operatives have wrenched the woman's arms behind her back. As she's escorted past, her stare widens in dawning recognition.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: Aren't... aren't you Thalia's assistant?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was then, but not anymore.

steps.speaker: Kara
steps.content: You planned this together...
You offer her a faint smile, a perfect mirror of Thalia's.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Miss Ellington and I just reached a pleasant agreement to collaborate.

Three Days Ago
After the Auction Ended
When Thalia's message finally comes, it's late, well past midnight, with a fine drizzle falling in the air.
The meeting spot she chooses is some distance from the auction house. She offers no explanation, but you suspect she wants to avoid the auction crowds.

By the time you arrive, the villa takes you by surprise. It's the kind of place that belongs to old money, luxurious and grand. Your shoes click against the stone path as you approach, and there she is, waiting at the top of the steps.
Thalia perches on the edge of the staircase, her usual poise softened. The Thalia you know would fret over the way her coat crumples beneath her. But not tonight.
At the sound of your footsteps, she glances up with a smile, pushing damp strands of hair from her face.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: How's your investigation going?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: FAC operatives searched the venue, but as you predicted, everyone there was extremely cautious. The investigation hasn't made much progress.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: However, as the FAC points out, even if we find the smuggled goods, securing a conviction won't be easy. If the suspects are just ordinary citizens, they can simply claim they had no idea the items were contaminated with Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What about you? Did you get what you were after?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I met the seller of the brooch. Heh, turns out she's an old friend of mine.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: She used to be my best friend... We were inseparable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If she were really your best friend... she'd know that brooch was yours.
Thalia lets out a chuckle, not saying anything.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: She's the mastermind you've been looking for. She has an extensive collection of Mania artifacts, and she wanted me to help move them through my livestreams.
After a moment of silence, Thalia speaks again.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I said yes.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...So I could make another deal with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What deal?
A soft snicker escapes Thalia's lips.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...You're awfully calm. Shouldn't you be asking what I stand to gain from telling you this?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I thought the deal you proposed before was fair, so I'm open to hearing what you're thinking now.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: FAC's suspicions aren't wrong. I've seen the contract, and the transferor's name isn't hers. So no, you can't tie those smuggled goods directly to her.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I did record her threatening me... but she was careful. Never outright said the items were Mania-contaminated. So that alone isn't enough evidence.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But... if I betray her now—when she thinks she's already won—she'll take it as the ultimate humiliation. And she will stop at nothing to destroy me.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: So tell me, if she does attack me... a threat recording plus assault charges, would that be enough to convict her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You want to expose her during a livestream.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if our goal is to catch them in the act, we can't promise immediate protection, and there's always the risk of retaliation. You'd be putting yourself in serious danger.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I know. But I'm willing to take that risk.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: So, what do you say?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...You still don't trust me?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: By telling me this, you've already made your decision, haven't you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was just thinking... The thing that matters most to you is right within reach. But instead of holding onto it, you're letting it go and putting yourself at risk, too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're all about win-win situations, so why are you doing this?
Thalia offers a faint smile and pats the empty space beside her.
As you settle in, something rustles inside your coat. The letter. You've nearly forgotten that a colleague at the Bureau asked you to deliver it to Thalia earlier.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: This is my family's ancestral home. And you see that swimming pool behind us? That's where my father drowned.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: The night before, I watched him drink himself into a stupor. I had this awful feeling, like he was about to do something irreversible. But I didn't dare think about what.
Thalia shakes her head gently to herself.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I never really knew my mother. And after that day, I didn't have a father, either.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Three days later, the bank was set to seize everything. This house, the pool, all of it. But because he killed himself, I had to take his place, working with the bank officials to inventory all our remaining assets.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: That person stopped at each and every item, asking me to confirm its value. And I had to watch as they wrote down numbers in their little book, packing away my life piece by piece.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Funny, though, all I could see was the dining table where we ate together. The mirror where we'd make stupid faces. The swing he built just for me.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: And the longer I stood there, the angrier I became. I hated him...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Why didn't he take me with him?
On the lawn before you, a swing stands silent in the rain.

You try to imagine: Long ago, a girl in a white dress sat there, her face fresh with youth. With a push of her feet, she soared skyward, hair and dress streaming behind her as the world stretched open before her.
Long ago.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: After that, none of it mattered. They would sit at the bank's auction, waiting for their next owners. And with them, that life I once had would be gone.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But I promised myself, quietly, that I'd get it all back. The house, my family, the memories...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...And my pathetic dignity.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You did get it back.
You raise your hand, gesturing toward the swing before you both.
Thalia's lips part—just for a breath—before twisting into a smile edged with quiet bitterness.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: When I bought this house back... the old swing was already gone. I built this one myself. Tried to match the memory as best I could.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I've come so far just to be back here... and yet, in the end, things are just things, aren't they?

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: ...Maybe I've been clinging too hard. I'm... a bit tired.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: This is...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My colleague at the Bureau gave me this earlier. It's a fan letter for you.
Thalia smooths the letter open across her knee, its pages illuminated by the dim glow of the porch lamp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The letter came from Syndicate. Looks like you've inspired quite a few people.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come to think of it, it's no surprise. From Eastside to Syndicate, then back to Eastside again... this whole time, you only had yourself. And you made it. That's something to be really proud of, don't you think?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At the very least, I admire you. The person you've always been, through everything.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What you were looking for? You found it a long time ago. Actually, you never lost it in the first place.
You watch her quietly. Raindrops bead on her lashes; when she blinks, they spill, dampening the letter.

The water's touch seems to startle her back to the present. With deliberate care, she folds the letter, tucking it into its envelope. Then she presses it to her chest, as if she could seal the words inside, beneath the steady drum of her heartbeat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I hope you never lose that, no matter where life takes you. And honestly, I can't wait to see where you'll go from here.
She chuckles softly and nods.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I know. I need to let go of the past.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: After all... I still have such a long road ahead, don't I?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well then, I'd love to be one of your loyal viewers, always cheering you on.
You offer your hand to Thalia. She meets it with hers, and your fingers weave together beneath the rain.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: To a successful partnership.
With Thalia's assistance, FAC and MBCC have gathered sufficient evidence, bringing the Mania smuggling case to a successful conclusion.
Thalia has also been cleared of all suspicions, and thanks to her outstanding contribution during the investigation, she is granted bail.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: These are your certification documents. Remember to bring all of them when you come back to the Bureau for your regular check-ins.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And one more thing...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I'm listening.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Kara's case is now in the trial phase. When it goes to court, you might need to testify as a witness.
Hearing your words, Thalia pauses, her fingers brushing thoughtfully over her left wrist. Beneath the sleek black leather of her glove, the faint outline of bandages lingers.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were just recently hurt by her. If you have concerns about seeing her again, I can file a request with the Public Security Bureau to have you classified as a protected witness. Then, you wouldn't need to appear in court.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: It's fine. I'm not afraid of her...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Though, if I'm being honest... maybe I'm a bit shaken in hindsight.

steps.speaker: Luminita
steps.content: You know... sometimes I wonder. If my father hadn't gone bankrupt, if none of it had happened... that could've been me. We were so close back then, it was like... she was me, and I was her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No. I think the Miss Ellington I know wouldn't have gone down that path.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh, come on. Don't you start being all formal with me.
She lifts her chin.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Just call me when the time comes. I'll be there.
You give her a nod.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh, and about your brooch, even though it was also contaminated, we might be able to remove the contamination and return it to you.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: If it's too much trouble, then don't worry about it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll think of something.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Oh, give me that look... Here, let me tell you something else. Actually, by auction standards, that brooch would be considered defective.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: When I was little, I once sneaked it out to play with and accidentally dropped it. A few of the diamonds chipped right off.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I was so scared, frozen stiff, but when my father found out, he told me...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: "A hummingbird was never meant to be burdened by the weight of gems. It's meant to brave the wind and rain, shedding what holds it back so it can soar freely into the blue sky."

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: He said that was the true meaning of our family crest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I really like that story.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Come to think of it, when I was little, I might've acted like a perfect little angel in public, but I was actually quite the handful at home.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not that surprising, actually.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But he never scolded me.
Thalia's voice drops to a whisper, the words slow and deliberate.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Actually... I think I miss him. Just a little.
Her gaze falters, flickering downward, but only for a heartbeat. Then she lifts her chin, brightening as her eyes meet yours again, a smile playing at her lips.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Everything else I have to say... I already told you that night.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see.
Thalia!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your actual assistant is here to pick you up.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Looks like it's time to say goodbye to my stand-in assistant.
Thalia waves at you before turning to walk toward the woman waiting in the distance. But after a few steps, she suddenly whirls around.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: But if you ever feel like switching things up, you're always welcome to intern with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Working for you? I'm not sure I could handle that.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm actually a pretty chill boss.
You share one last smile, a fleeting wave, and bid each other goodbye—officially this time.
You watch as she walks away, her stride light yet deliberate, the sharp click of her heels against the pavement fading into the city's distant clamor.
Above, the sky stretches endless and blue. DisCity's rains have passed at last, and the forecast promises nothing but sunshine ahead.
She still has such a long road ahead of her.
